topics.title: Declarative View Hierarchy & Stacks (VStack, HStack, ZStack)
topics.objective: Compose adaptive native iOS user interfaces declaratively using view modifiers and nested stacks.
topics.exercise: Build a responsive profile card layout with an avatar image, badges, and action buttons.

topics.title: @State, @Binding & Two-Way Data Flow
topics.objective: Manage local view state and propagate two-way data bindings to reusable child components.
topics.example: @State private var isEnabled: Bool = false; Toggle('Active', isOn: $isEnabled)
topics.exercise: Create a reusable toggle filter component that mutates state owned by a parent view.

topics.title: @Observable and StateObject Architecture
topics.objective: Decouple business logic and network requests from presentation using observable view models.
topics.exercise: Implement an async view model that fetches paginated JSON items from an API and updates UI state.

topics.title: NavigationStack & Path-Based Routing
topics.objective: Architect deep-linkable native navigation paths with typed destinations and programmatic pop/push.
topics.exercise: Construct a master-detail e-commerce catalog with drill-down item views and cart checkout modals.

topics.title: Implicit & Explicit Spring Animations
topics.objective: Polish mobile UX with interactive spring physics and matched geometry effect transitions.
topics.exercise: Animate an expandable card view smoothly transitioning between summary and fullscreen detail modes.
